sources.title: A Walkthrough of Hugging Face ml-intern Automating LLM Post-Training
sources.snippet: Hugging Face recently introduced ml-intern, an open-source AI agent built on the smolagents framework that autonomously handles LLM post-training workflows. This walkthrough explores how to leverage the repository to automate fine-tuning, debugging, and model evaluation.
